I keep reinstalling and uninstalling every six months because of several user-unfriendly issues. 

It interferes with Youtube (and other sites) shortcuts. Once you install this, you lose many Youtube shortcuts like the "f" for fullscreen. 

It's impossible to have links activated by default. You have to hit "f" every single time you want to click. Hitting f again does not make the lables disappear, it makes you follow a link instead. 

You cannot hit a link by typing its innerText. If a link reads "hello", I should be able to access it by typing "hello".

Good idea, poor implementation. This app creates more problems than it solves.
reviews.dev_reply:
> The disable function doesn't work, so it's impossible to use default Youtube shortcuts.

Really, works perfectly for me, and has done for years.  Have you tried this... https://github.com/philc/vimium/wiki/Disabling-Vimium.

> You cannot hit a link by typing its innerText.

You're looking for "Use the link's name and characters for link-hint filtering" on the options page (under advanced).
